summary: Frontend smoke test PASSED. Bundle compilation confirmed (iOS 200 / Android 200, both valid JS with no error JSON). Web preview boots without red screen. Home renders all 8 testIDs (home-screen, home-brand, home-hero-banner, home-riforma-card, home-card-navigatore, home-card-progetto, home-card-tracker, home-card-supporto). Navigation to /progetto works: progetto-screen and progetto-area-casa visible; tapping progetto-chip-casa-0 updates progetto-counter to '1 desiderio in 1 area'. Navigation to /tracker works: tracker-reassure and tracker-progetto-link visible. Direct navigation to /contatti, /territorio, /hub all render without crashes. No page errors, no 'Unable to resolve' / 'is not a function' / 'Cannot read' runtime errors in console. Only benign RN Web deprecation warnings for shadow*/textShadow* style props.

react_native_issues.issue: Console shows repeated warnings: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' and '"textShadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "textShadow"'. Non-blocking on native, but should migrate to boxShadow/textShadow for RN 0.86 web compatibility.

action_items: (Optional / non-blocking) Migrate deprecated shadow*/textShadow* StyleSheet props to boxShadow/textShadow to silence RN 0.86 web deprecation warnings.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App boots cleanly on Expo Go / web preview after TS fixes. iOS + Android Metro bundles compile to valid JS (~9.5MB / ~9.9MB). All home/progetto/tracker/contatti/territorio/hub screens render. No runtime resolution errors. Only cosmetic deprecation warnings for shadow* style props remain.
